description: Register one of your APIs or MCP servers as a connector, so your sourced monitors can watch it. Inputs: id (unique within your account), kind ('mcp' for an MCP server, 'https_json' for an HTTPS endpoint answering JSON with url plus text, paragraph_text or title, 'pauhu_sources' for the Pauhu sources your plan covers), endpoint_url, label, auth_kind ('bearer' with the name of your stored token, or 'none' for a public endpoint), and optionally mcp_tool_name (default 'search') and poll_fallback_secs. Returns the registered connector. Monitor runs over your connectors carry no per-run token charge.

auth_kind.description: 'bearer' (with the name of your stored token) or 'none' for a public endpoint

endpoint_url.description: Your endpoint URL (HTTPS JSON endpoint or MCP server URL)

id.description: Unique connector id within your account

label.description: Human-readable label shown in your connector list

mcp_tool_name.description: MCP tool to invoke (for kind=mcp; defaults to 'search')

poll_fallback_secs.description: Optional poll cadence (seconds) for sources without push semantics

token_ref.description: Name of the bearer token you stored with Pauhu (for auth_kind=bearer)

name: monitor_register_connector
title: Monitor: register a connector (your API or MCP)
